tasks.label: MG 2: verify all episodes on Windows (.NET + Pester)
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force '${workspaceFolder}\verify-results' | Out-Null; Start-Transcript -Path '${workspaceFolder}\verify-results\transcript.txt' -Force | Out-Null; try { & '${workspaceFolder}\series\tools\Invoke-WindowsVerification.ps1' } catch { $_ | Out-String | Write-Host -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 } finally { Stop-Transcript | Out-Null }

tasks.label: MG 3: rerun only the failed episodes
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force '${workspaceFolder}\verify-results-rerun' | Out-Null; Start-Transcript -Path '${workspaceFolder}\verify-results-rerun\transcript.txt' -Force | Out-Null; try { & '${workspaceFolder}\series\tools\Invoke-WindowsVerification.ps1' -RerunFailed } catch { $_ | Out-String | Write-Host -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 } finally { Stop-Transcript | Out-Null }
